title: The edge spectral extremal problem for odd wheels in nonzero residue classes
summary: For a fixed integer $k\ge 2$, let $W_{2k+1}=K_1\vee C_{2k}$ be an odd wheel graph. The fixed-size spectral extremal problem aims to determine \[ \operatorname{spex}(m,W_{2k+1}):=\max\{ρ(G): e(G)=m,\ G \text{ is } W_{2k+1}\text{-free}\}, \] where $ρ(G)$ denotes the adjacency spectral radius. Based on this problem, Yu, Li, and Peng [18] proposed the following conjecture: For large $m$, every $W_{2k+1}$-free graph of size $m$ satisfies $ρ(G)^2-(k-1)ρ(G)\le m-\binom{k}{2}$ with equality precisely for $K_k\vee qK_1$ and $m-\binom{k}{2}=kq$.
